camera.shot_scale_bias: medium shots on a small practical set

lens.focal_bias: a 50mm lens on a miniature set
lens.dof: shallow, betraying the small scale of the build

sources: a warm key with soft fill
lighting.practicals: lighting is stable frame to frame, as a stop-motion stage requires

rules: visible fingerprints and tool marks in the clay
handmade set dressing with fabric and card
composition.movement_of_subject: movement steps forward in small increments with a faint frame-to-frame judder

sound.ambience_bias: close quiet studio room tone with small handled-object sounds

music.instrumentation: A light woodwind and pizzicato string melody
music.dynamics: bouncing along with small accents on the action

must_include: characters are modelled in plasticine with visible fingerprints
motion advances in small stop-motion increments rather than smoothly

notes: Handmade plasticine puppets on a miniature practical set, with the frame-stepped motion of real stop-motion.
